title: CmdPal: Reload stops extensions before removing their commands (EXT26.T1)

evidence: The isolated test reproduced registry mutation after first disposal and left commands/bands published.
The issue says fixing enumeration alone does not fix stop-before-clear ordering.
Current ReloadAllCommandsAsyncCore awaits service stop before local retirement.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the targeted maintainer reproduction to validate the proposed mechanism before design approval; no upstream action has been taken.
judgment.rationale: The report distinguishes remote-stop ordering from registry enumeration and includes an isolated mutation case leaving commands/bands published. The local-retirement-before-remote-stop correction is independently testable.

fix_assessment.rationale: No matching fix was found by focused issue-number search; treat the reported mechanism as a hypothesis and validate before implementation.

verification: With commands/bands from two providers, block or fail the first stop and verify local retirement precedes its completion.
Mutate the registry during stop and verify later providers are still attempted.
Perform a later healthy reload and confirm new commands/bands load.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Reload awaits potentially failing remote stop before retiring callbacks and published items; if stop blocks or aborts, local cleanup is delayed or skipped.
plan: Close admission to old-load updates and snapshot provider lifetimes being retired.
Retire callbacks and remove old commands/bands locally before remote stop calls.
Attempt remote cleanup independently so one failure does not block reload recovery.
Test stop failure/hang, registry mutation and later healthy reload.

confidence.rationale: An isolated mutation case and source ordering support the defect; blocked stop and recovery need focused tests.

design.title: Correct the reported Command Palette extension lifecycle failure

reproduce.version_requirement: Current main/dev build; report references main ef43bf8.
prerequisites: Two controllable providers with published commands/bands and a stop failure/block seam.
reproduce.expected_result: Local items/callbacks are retired regardless of remote stop failure and later reload succeeds.
steps: 1. Load two providers and confirm commands/bands are published.
2. Begin reload while the first provider's stop blocks or throws; inspect local retirement.
3. Mutate the registry during stop, verify remaining attempts, then run a healthy reload.
